finding: BOTH ARMS SHOW THE SAME LOSS: one of four required rows present ('Uncertainty'), with the same not-streamed statement. In the OFF arm the far-tier status element is ABSENT entirely (farTierArmed false), so the tier contributed nothing at all, and the loss is unchanged.
armCaveat: In the ON arm the far tier was armed but had drawn 0 cells at sample time -- at this pose it had not finished declaring within the 50 s dwell. That weakens the ON arm as a 'far tier fully present' reading. It does NOT weaken the conclusion, which rests on the OFF arm: with the tier wholly disarmed the rows are still missing.
conclusion: The row loss is NOT caused by the far tier. It is consistent with the -s1 to -s2 two-LOD serving promotion changing which cells are resident at this camera, and is recorded against ADR 0057.
whatThisDoesNotShow: It does not measure how many buildings are affected -- one building, one pose.
It does not identify which specific change in the -s2 promotion moved residency; it excludes the far tier and points at the promotion.
